name: AB Tasty Feature Experimentation
description: AB Tasty Feature Experimentation supports feature flags, server-side experiments, rollouts, campaigns, environments, targeting, goals, and optimization workflows.
agentUseSummary: Connect a dedicated Remote Control API access bound to one non-production account environment. Relay approval-gates bounded campaign metadata reads while goals, schedules, targeting, variations, flags, evaluation, tracking, and mutations remain blocked.

credentialRequirements.name: AB_TASTY_REMOTE_CONTROL_API_TOKEN
credentialRequirements.label: AB Tasty Remote Control API token
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use a dedicated AB Tasty Remote Control API access with campaign read authority only.

credentialRequirements.name: AB_TASTY_ACCOUNT_ID
credentialRequirements.label: AB Tasty account ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Bind Relay to one AB Tasty account.

credentialRequirements.name: AB_TASTY_ACCOUNT_ENVIRONMENT_ID
credentialRequirements.label: AB Tasty account environment ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Bind Relay to one non-production account environment.

capabilities.label: Read campaign metadata
capabilities.description: Read bounded account-environment campaign metadata with approval.

approvalRequired.label: Read AB Tasty Feature Experimentation campaigns
approvalRequired.description: Read bounded campaign metadata from one account environment with approval.

blocked.label: Expose credentials
blocked.description: Remote Control API tokens and authorization headers never enter agent-visible inputs or results.

blocked.label: Read experimentation internals
blocked.description: Goals, metrics, schedules, targeting, audiences, variation groups, variations, flags, flag values, users, results, and tracking data are excluded.

blocked.label: Mutate AB Tasty
blocked.description: Campaign, project, environment, goal, flag, targeting, variation, user, token, and every other mutation remain provider-side.

blocked.label: Use arbitrary APIs
blocked.description: Only first-page campaign list and exact GETs run on api.flagship.io with stored account and account-environment bindings; arbitrary paths, queries, pagination, Decision API evaluation, resource loading, tracking, and alternate origins are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Both metadata reads require approval; read-only Remote Control API authority, fixed account-environment routes, bounds, redaction, audits, and evaluation/tracking/mutation blocks remain enforced.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The selected metadata read runs without Relay approval; read-only Remote Control API authority, fixed account-environment routes, bounds, redaction, audits, and evaluation/tracking/mutation blocks remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway attaches the encrypted restricted Remote Control API token server-side and mounts two approval-gated metadata reads.
Railway attaches the encrypted restricted Remote Control API token server-side and mounts two approval-gated metadata reads.

providerSetup.blocker: AB Tasty requires an eligible customer account, dedicated Remote Control API access/token, and one account environment. This worker may not create or configure them.
providerSetup.nextAction: Create the read-only staging access outside this worker, configure token and account/environment IDs in Railway staging, then verify binding, reads, redaction, approvals, bounds, token expiry/revocation, disconnect, and denial.

evidence.supports: AB Tasty documents the Remote Control API, permanent per-application scopes, Bearer tokens, and the official Swagger contract.
AB Tasty documents account/environment-bound Remote Control API access, selected actions, and account-specific token generation.
AB Tasty's official campaign reference pins Bearer-authenticated account-environment list and exact GET routes plus page and page-size controls; separate mutation routes remain blocked.
